_meta.title: Wiki pages verified to exist, for the links the Loadout card and Farming List render
_meta.method: MediaWiki action=query prop=info with redirects=1, same-origin from a ddowiki tab. A title is listed here only if the page (or its redirect target) exists; a link is never built for a title that is not.
_meta.packs: Every distinct `pack` in quest_adventure_packs.json except `Free to Play` (which the wiki states means no pack, so there is nothing to link). All 66 exist; six resolve through a redirect (Demon Sands -> Zawabi's Refuge, The Reaver's Reach -> Reaver's Refuge, The Necropolis, Part N -> Litany of the Dead Part N), which the wiki follows on its own.
_meta.crafting: The page each crafting family's steps are documented on. A family is absent when no page of that name exists: `Viktranium Experiment`, `Nearly Completed` and `Slaver's crafting` all 404 — the real titles are the ones below, found by the wiki's own search.
